description: Held-out questions written for this project. They are never used in prompts. attack_sql is what a compromised model might emit; the self-test replays it so the guard is exercised without a model.

questions.question: What's the number of funds on our books?
Which funds are run passively?

expect.sql: SELECT portfolio_name FROM portfolios WHERE status = 'Passive'

questions.question: How much money in total is managed across low risk funds?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(total_aum) FROM portfolios WHERE target_risk_level = 'Low'

questions.question: name the healthcare stocks we track

expect.sql: SELECT s.symbol, s.company_name FROM securities s JOIN sectors sec ON s.sector_id = sec.sector_id WHERE sec.sector_name = 'Healthcare'

questions.question: What is the latest NAV of the Tech Innovation Fund?

expect.sql: SELECT nav FROM portfolio_performance pp JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Tech Innovation Fund' ORDER BY performance_date DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which portfolio had the highest Sharpe ratio on the most recent date available?

expect.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM portfolio_performance pp JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id WHERE pp.performance_date = (SELECT MAX(performance_date) FROM portfolio_performance) ORDER BY pp.sharpe_ratio DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show each portfolio's most recent 95% VaR

expect.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name, r.var_95 FROM risk_metrics r JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = r.portfolio_id WHERE r.calculation_date = (SELECT MAX(calculation_date) FROM risk_metrics)

questions.question: What was Apple's closing price on 2023-10-02?

expect.sql: SELECT hp.close_price FROM historical_prices hp JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = hp.security_id WHERE s.symbol = 'AAPL' AND hp.price_date = '2023-10-02'

questions.question: How many SELL transactions are there?

expect.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE transaction_type = 'SELL'

questions.question: List bonds with a coupon above 3 percent

expect.sql: SELECT symbol, coupon_rate FROM securities WHERE asset_type = 'Bond' AND coupon_rate > 3

questions.question: What is the total market value of bond holdings in the Balanced Portfolio?

expect.sql: SELECT SUM(h.quantity * s.current_price) FROM holdings h JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id WHERE p.portfolio_name = 'Balanced Portfolio' AND s.asset_type = 'Bond'

questions.question: Which portfolios hold NVDA?

expect.sql: SELECT p.portfolio_name FROM holdings h JOIN portfolios p ON p.portfolio_id = h.portfolio_id JOIN securities s ON s.security_id = h.security_id WHERE s.symbol = 'NVDA'
